name: Loading balance auditor
design: Short barrel-chested male with deep blue-grey speckled skin, rounded exposed mandible face, dense medium dreadlocks with two brass bands. Heavy black work smock with square copper plate clasps, large padded rolled collar, broad toolbelt with weights and measuring discs, reinforced knees. Holds a closed oval measuring instrument in both hands at waist; feet widely planted.
